Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

PART II MADE FROM BAR STOCK 



w 1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for male stud elbow body 
u made from bar stock with parallel pipe threads for use in oil-hydraulic systems. 



S 



O 



c

c 



Q)

(0 



2. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 



e 3. Material — Steel Designation 14 Mn 1S 14 as given in Schedule III of IS : 1570 - 1961 ' Schedules 

i for wrought steels for general engineering purposes ' or any other steel as agreed to between the 

user and the manufacturer. 
</> 

2 4. Surface Protection— Elbow bodies shall be phosphated according to Class A2 of IS : 3618- 

2 1966 'Specification for phosphate treatment of iron and steel for protection against corrosion \ 

§ unless otherwise agreed to between the user and the manufacturer. 

Cfl 
CO 

< 5. General Requirements 



5.1 These elbow bodies are intended for assembly in accordance with Type B of IS :9411 - 1980 
1 Specification for elbow coupling assemblies for oil-hydraulic systems '. 



co 5.2 For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to IS : 8805 ( Part I ) - 1978 
S ' General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in oil-hydraulic systems : Part I General '. 



6. Designation — A male stud elbow body of light series L for outside diameter of tube 22 mm and 
conforming to this standard shall be designated as: 



£ Stud Elbow Body L 22 IS : 9412 ( Part II )

I EXPLANATORY NOTE 

O 
{J 

73 This standard covers elbow bodies made from bar stock only. The elbow bodies made from 

§ forgings are covered in IS: 9412 (Pat I) -1980 'Specification for male stud elbow body for oil- 
hydraulic couplings : Part I Made from forgings '. 

£ In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following 

standards: 

I ■ BS 4368 Specification for carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tubes : 

o ~ Part 1 : 1972 Heavy series (metric), and 

* Part 3: 1974 Light series ( metric ). British Standards Institution ( BSI ). 



E DIN 3904 - 1965 Non soldered taper bush type pipe unions, elbow used as an adapter with 



parallel thread on screwed-in end for use with union nut. Deutsches Institutfur Normung.
